title: Protect a class invariant
prompt: Dimension stores a positive size. Its constructor rejects zero or negative values with std::invalid_argument; set does the same and leaves the old value untouched. The value() observer never changes the object.
signature: class Dimension: constructor(int), void set(int), int value() const

tests.label: Reject zero constructor
tests.hint: Reject before callers can use an invalid object.

hints: Put the check before the assignment.
A constructor can throw to stop an invalid object from being used.
explanation: The invariant is value_ > 0 after every successful operation. A rejected update has no visible change. const on value() promises not to edit the Dimension.
